name: stays
description: Rooms, flats and houses to stay in while away.
howDealsGo: The guest pays into escrow at booking and releases once the place is as described, at check-in or at the end. A timer to the host, set past check-out, pays for a stay that happened if the guest goes quiet; a deposit, if any, is a second escrow released back to the guest. Before paying, check the host's standing and get the exact address.
